title: Military Working Dogs (FM 3-19.17)
goal: Handler fundamentals grounded in FM 3-19.17 for readiness and animal welfare.

sources.title: MilitaryWorkingDogFM3-19_17
sources.note: FM 3-19.17 July 2005 text (+ chapter audio on same folder)

weeks.title: Doctrine and roles
weeks.objective: State what an MWD team is for and the handler's responsibilities per FM 3-19.17.
weeks.activity: Read chapter 1 excerpt; list three handler duties in your own words citing S1.
weeks.assessment: Can name roles without inventing policy beyond the FM.

weeks.title: Selection and care basics
weeks.objective: Describe selection/care themes covered in the FM without improvising vet protocols.
weeks.activity: From S1, extract care checklist items that appear in the text; flag gaps for a vet.
weeks.assessment: Checklist items map to cited lines; gaps listed honestly.

weeks.title: Training fundamentals
weeks.objective: Outline training principles present in the FM.
weeks.activity: Build a one-page week plan that only uses techniques named in S1.

weeks.title: Employment and safety
weeks.objective: Explain employment/safety notes from the manual.
weeks.activity: Scenario: list safety checks before a training evolution, all cited to S1.
weeks.assessment: Safety list cites S1; marks unknowns.

weeks.title: Records and accountability
weeks.objective: Identify record-keeping / accountability themes in the FM.
weeks.activity: Draft a blank log template fields that the FM implies; cite.

weeks.title: Capstone brief
weeks.objective: Deliver a short handler brief grounded only in S1 + your notes.
weeks.activity: 5-minute brief: mission, care, training, safety — with source ids.
weeks.assessment: Peer/tutor can spot any unsourced claim.

gaps: Confirm local/unit SOPs superseding FM where applicable
Veterinary protocols need qualified human oversight — not invented by tutor
tutor_notes: Adult professional tone. Never invent DoD credentials. Cite S1. Audio chapters in same folder may support lecture mode via NOVA later.
